name: Aerial Scout
description: Maps outcrops and photographs inaccessible terrain from above.

name: Airlift Survey
description: Provides access to remote sites and aerial observation of large exposures.

name: Formation Map
description: Locates rocks of the correct age and depositional environment.

name: Geo Compass
description: Points toward the nearest undiscovered site without revealing its exact distance.

name: Orbit Survey
description: Identifies exposed formations, erosion zones and terrain worth surveying.

name: Proximity Scanner
description: Indicates whether the player is moving closer to or farther from the nearest undiscovered site.

name: Site Navigator
description: Combines directional guidance with an estimated distance to the nearest undiscovered site.

name: Controlled Break
description: Removes large volumes of sterile rock only under professional geological supervision.

name: Earth Mover
description: Removes confirmed sterile overburden far above the fossil-bearing layer.

name: Field Beam
description: Illuminates caves, crevices and shaded rock surfaces during inspection.

name: Ridge Glass
description: Helps inspect distant slopes, cliffs and exposed sedimentary beds.

name: Rock Breaker
description: Breaks resistant matrix at a safe distance from exposed fossils.

name: Thermal Survey
description: Detects temperature differences that may reveal fractures or shallow geological structures.

name: Field Canopy
description: Protects an exposed excavation from sun, rain and wind.

name: Field Codex
description: Records locality, geology, specimen context and excavation decisions.

name: Perimeter Guard
description: Prevents visitors, animals and vehicles from damaging the site.

name: Site Veil
description: Covers excavated surfaces during pauses or bad weather.

name: Detail Brush
description: Clears loose sediment from exposed fossil surfaces.

name: Field Trowel
description: Cleans excavation surfaces and removes sediment around larger bones.

name: Geo Hammer
description: Splits rock and drives chisels during controlled excavation.

name: Matrix Chisel
description: Removes compact rock from around a fossil in small controlled sections.

name: Precision Pick
description: Removes fine matrix from small anatomical details.

name: Acid Bath
description: Dissolves suitable carbonate matrix under controlled laboratory conditions.

name: Air Scribe
description: Mechanically removes hard matrix with rapid, precise impacts.

name: Bone Seal
description: Penetrates fragile fossil material to reduce cracking and flaking.

name: Foil Barrier
description: Separates fossil surfaces from plaster, adhesives or packing materials.

name: Precision Bond
description: Reattaches broken fragments using a documented and preferably reversible adhesive.

name: Support Wrap
description: Temporarily supports fractured or delicate material before extraction.

name: Block Lift
description: Raises large jacketed blocks while distributing their weight safely.

name: Jacket Wrap
description: Creates a fast protective jacket around smaller fossil blocks.

name: Plaster Shell
description: Encases a fossil and surrounding matrix in a rigid protective shell.

name: Airlift Rig
description: Removes heavy specimens from sites without practical road access.

name: Field Case
description: Protects small fossils from impact, vibration and displacement.

name: Flatbed Carrier
description: Transports large jackets, crates and quarry equipment.

name: Quarry Sled
description: Moves heavy jackets across rough terrain without repeated lifting.

name: Specimen Cradle
description: Supports irregular fossils without concentrating pressure on fragile areas.

name: Archive Deposit
description: Transfers a specimen and its documentation to an approved scientific collection.

name: Climate Sentinel
description: Monitors environmental conditions that could damage stored fossils.

name: Collection Vault
description: Stores catalogued specimens in a stable and organized environment.

name: Anatomy Archive
description: Compares a specimen with identified skeletons, casts and reference material.

name: CT Vault
description: Reveals internal anatomy and enclosed structures without physically opening the fossil.

name: Isotope Engine
description: Investigates diet, environment, migration or alteration using isotopic composition.

name: Micro Lens
description: Examines fine anatomy, surface textures, sediments and microfossils.

name: Radiometric Clock
description: Dates suitable volcanic minerals or layers associated with the fossil site.

name: Strata Reader
description: Determines the fossil's position and context within the surrounding rock sequence.

name: Surface Scanner
description: Produces an accurate digital model of a fossil or excavation surface.

name: UV Revealer
description: Makes some fossils, repairs and minerals easier to distinguish through fluorescence.

name: Digital Restorer
description: Reassembles scanned elements and tests alternative anatomical arrangements.

name: Missing Element Model
description: Estimates absent bones from mirrored anatomy and closely related specimens.

name: Mount Armature
description: Supports an assembled skeleton while minimizing contact with original bones.

name: Soft-Tissue Model
description: Estimates muscles and other missing tissues using attachment marks and living relatives.
